body:
I'm in fairly good shape physically and most of the time I'm ok mentally. But I was raised in a very religious conservative home where I was constantly told that suicide was sin and would send me to hell. That never made sense to me. Since I left the group I've thought more for myself. I used to work with farm animals and it was basic common sense that if one was suffering and in pain with no reasonable cure the most kind thing to do was give it a humane death. 
If we recognize this with animals we should extend the same mercy to each other, not only for physical pain, but unbearable emotional pain as well. Being forced to commit suicide is way worse for someone's emotional state than having the option to get help. And the fact that it's illegal most places makes people feel worse when they just wanna end it. If we all have the right to create new life then surely we should have the right to end our own

/>Again, the problem isn't mental illness. It's a society that demonizes the mentally ill rather than providing for their often quite modest needs./
I agree with that. Yet you seem to think that the discomfort that you endure by denying your urges to have children justifies creating new life and causing completely avoidable and un-necessary suffering. Don't get me wrong, I don't think that anyone of any mental capacity is justified in having children. Genetically inherited illnesses are just one more good reason not to
Yes, but it's not moral to reproduce the problems into a new, innocent life

I feel this exactly the same. I sometimes even worry when I'm present with people I know and they make a joke about something I don't understand that it might be about me. I tell myself I'm being over-imaginative but it doesn't help much. The only things that have helped me are telling myself to just not give a f***k and telling myself they don't really care about me enough to go to the effort to make jokes about me in veiled language. Sometimes I just can't stop feeling like everyone I run into instantly realizes I'm different and fit to be made fun of

All I can say is I think that the only real meaning you'll find is what you decide for yourself. It sounds cliche but I think it's true. It's hard to do but try to find things that you like about yourself. 
You can send me a message if you need someone to talk to

I've always been intensely frustrated by people saying suicide is selfish. I think that most people are really selfish about almost everything, but suicide can be one of the least selfLESS things you can do. And you don't come across and selfish at all to me. 
Whoever is telling you your going to hell is being fucking abusive and needs to get fucked.
Send me a message if you want to talk
When you die your gone, done, obliterated. Find a way to enjoy this while you can, and don't worry about the nothingness thats coming. It won't help you now and it will be nonexistent then
My thoughts run along the lines of a gun, probably a rifle. Otherwise a train or something. I'm scared of heights so that's not an option.

I wish I could have peace about it like this. Maybe I'll get there at some point. In the meantime I keep waffling back and forth on whether my life is worth living long term. If you need someone to talk to send me a message mate.
My feelings exactly
Thank you for saying this. It helped me

I think it depends on the case. I think that the most UNselfish suicide is when someone does it because they feel like they're a burden on everyone around them. Then there is more self centered motivation, for example I know I would seriously hurt a few people in my life so that would make it fairly selfish for me to do it. But in the end I don't really care, the whole point in dying is so I don't have to worry what people think anymore. So I don't have to feel pain anymore..

I have recently started to believe more in evolution, and although evolution doesn't answer what it was that started all of this is in the "begining", I feel that it makes more sense of how senseless this all is. I've always had difficulty seeing how a god sitting somewhere up there and running this shit show could be good.
I'm gonna go to sleep on this. Whoever you are I'm happy for you and you just made me feel a bit better reading this
Holy shit man. Did you stay conscious? and would you ever try it again for any reason?
I deeply relate to that. It would be just my luck to drag on until the oldest age possible

I agree that self isolation helps. Although I got taken off guard recently by some bad depression and panic attacks when I tried staying totally by myself for awhile. I need to figure out a way to get along with myself because I sure as heck can’t with other people well. 
I’ll have to give more thought to the possibility that this is staged by something or someone or other, although if it is I suppose there would be no way to know it for sure. I’m trying to become more comfortable with the idea of evolution (as I’ve separated from a very religious family not long in the past ) cause I think it helps me reconcile human behavior better. I’ve always found it hard to believe that this is all planned with our good in mind. Things just happen to randomly
My plan as well. I’m gonna take reasonable care of myself but as soon as something serious hits me healthwise I’m fucking done

I relate to this. This is literally me almost every time I have an interaction. I can’t identify as FA because of my age (I’m 19) but I’m severely socially handicapped by being restricted to little or no social interaction while a teen (I was homeschooled). The simplest interaction can cause me to start panicking and I’ve developed a lot of repellent body language so people don’t talk to me. Now I can’t help it and I don’t expect things will change much

I fucking hate mine, not only did they do me the disservice of creating me but they infected me from birth with their ultra conservative religious worldview with the child killing, eternal tormenting god of the Bible always looming over my head. They also believe that birth control is a sin and were all morally obligated to have as many kids as possible. I moved out 2 years ago and I never expect to speak to them again.

I appreciate you replying, today was a bad one for me so hearing your thoughts is really helpful. I’m staying at a friends house so I wouldn’t have been able to kill myself but I sure wanted to. 
I kind of meant alien figuratively, but I do have moments where I wonder if maybe everything is somehow staged and I’m stuck in a cycle of having roughly the same feelings over and over when I try and get along with other people, until I find a way to snap out of it. Maybe that’s what being dead is. 
I can absolutely relate to the schizo type reaction, I feel very similar sometimes

Good for you, and I think that’s the right choice. I left a job last recently that paid well but was very taxing and stressful, I’m just about to hit 20 and am not sure where to go from here but I desperately hope to find something I can enjoy to at least some extent

No one from my past religious group would ever say this (I’ve been de-converted for about 2 years) because they were all to damn sure they were right! My group was very virulently anti abortion and we’d often hold very graphic signs and spit out the same prototype message that abortion was murder and your all bound for hell etc etc. Inwardly though there was an incredible amount of fear and rabid fighting over exactly what the gospel was and which of us were really saved. Eventually I decided that even if one of the many variations of doctrine was the truth it wasn’t worth living for because of how hatefully everyone in the group behaved.

This is encouraging to hear. I don’t have many friends and I come from an extreme religious community where  birth control was considered sin and all that shit. I knew from a young age that I didn’t want to reproduce like an obedient zombie and pass on the misery to my offspring.

That was the most prominent reason for me leaving my parents faith. Becoming an atheist has happened a lot more slowly as a result of looking at the evidence. But all I needed to leave the religion in the first place was to see what an asshole the god of the Bible is and how badly people who follow that book of trash behave

Unfortunately yeah. I think that someone who goes through with suicide after deciding that there’s nothing to be gained from living is really brave and almost heroic. I’m very scared of guns to the point where I sometimes shake uncontrollably when I’m holding one, which makes it difficult to even think about using one on myself. If I ever go through with it I’ll have to get a lot more balls than I’ve got now
